name: apply-modifiers
description: Modifier keywords shared across the 'block ... apply' family to vary a condition in space or time and to remove it: spatial gradients, FISH/table functions, and apply-remove. All 'block face apply' / 'block gridpoint apply' conditions REQUIRE a 'range' (live 9.7.47: 'A range must be specified').

notes: Per-axis gradient keywords vary the applied value with position — live 9.7 has gradient-x/gradient-y/gradient-z on 'block face apply' ONLY; 'block gridpoint apply' has no gradient keywords (use 'fish' there instead).
There is NO 'origin' keyword in the live 9.7 apply enumerations (removed from this file — previously listed in error).
'block gridpoint initialize <field> <value>' has its own modifier slot: add gradient multiply vary (live-enumerated) — see initial-conditions.
'fish <fn>' or 'table <name>' make the applied value a function of time/state.
Live on both 'block face apply' and 'block gridpoint apply' (and on rigid-block 'block apply').
'block face apply-remove ...' / 'block gridpoint apply-remove ...' clears conditions.
The removal keyword sets differ from the apply side: face apply-remove uses 'load(-x/y/z)' for point loads (not 'point-load'), and drops the fish/table/gradient modifiers (live-enumerated).
